summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Lumen.Study MVP. 21/21 backend pytest tests passed including auth, profile, rooms (public+private+passcode), pomodoro lifecycle, chat, tasks, sessions/log, dashboard, leaderboard, and AI recommendations via Claude Sonnet 4.5. Frontend tested via Playwright with injected session_token in localStorage: landing CTA, protected route redirect, dashboard, explore, create-room dialog -> navigation to room view, room view (focus toggle, pomodoro/participant/task/chat testids), leaderboard, profile save, AI widget rendered.

issues: Recharts ResponsiveContainer logs harmless width(-1)/height(-1) warnings during initial render transitions; consider setting minHeight on parent.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_current_user: if expires_at is missing/None, code will crash on .tzinfo access. Add null guard.

/api/leaderboard does NOT require authentication (no Depends(get_current_user)). Probably intentional (public board) but inconsistent with rest of API and exposes user names/pictures publicly. Confirm intent.
AI recommend endpoint has no timeout/rate limiting; a slow Claude call can block a worker for tens of seconds. Consider adding per-user cooldown or async background generation with caching.
Pomodoro start without payload.mode but with payload.duration_seconds overwrites paused_remaining even mid-run; consider preserving in-flight remaining unless reset.
auth_session: emergent OAuth network call has no retry; transient failures yield 401 to user. Minor.
DRY: token extraction (cookie or Bearer) duplicated in get_current_user and auth_logout. Extract helper.
Frontend AuthContext: on 401 from /auth/me it silently clears user; OK but consider not calling /auth/me when no localStorage token AND no cookie to reduce console errors on landing.
test_credentials: Synthetic users + sessions seeded directly in MongoDB per /app/auth_testing.md. Backend host token used as Authorization: Bearer header; frontend token injected into localStorage.session_token before navigation.
seed_data_creation: Tests insert TEST_-prefixed users, rooms, messages, tasks, study_sessions and clean up at session end via pymongo fixture. A few TEST_fe_* docs may remain from Playwright run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is fully passing and reusable. Uses MONGO_URL+DB_NAME from env to seed sessions, REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL for HTTP. For UI, inject localStorage.session_token before navigating to a protected route; the axios interceptor in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js sends it as Bearer. Polling intervals (chat 2.5s, room 3s, tasks 5s) work as expected.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs reproduced. All listed acceptance criteria met.
